variables.name: images
variables.expression: object.spec.containers.map(c, c.image) + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers.map(c, c.image) : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers.map(c, c.image) : [])

validations.message: SENTRYCHECK: the configured or required RuntimeClass must have exactly one current controller snapshot entry.
SENTRYCHECK: runtime has no verified healthy scheduling target or its handler configuration differs.

validations.expression: variables.managed.all(r, has(object.spec.nodeSelector) && r.selectorKey in object.spec.nodeSelector && object.spec.nodeSelector[r.selectorKey] == r.selectorValue && 'kubernetes.io/arch' in object.spec.nodeSelector && object.spec.nodeSelector['kubernetes.io/arch'] == r.architecture && (!has(object.spec.nodeName) || object.spec.nodeName == '' || object.spec.nodeName in r.healthyNodes))
validations.message: SENTRYCHECK: Pod must retain the RuntimeClass health and architecture selectors; a direct node assignment must be verified.

validations.expression: size(variables.managed) == 0 || variables.images.all(c, c.matches('^[^@]+@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$') && variables.managed.all(r, params.spec.images.exists(i, i.runtime == r.runtime && i.version == r.version && i.architecture == r.architecture && c.endsWith('@' + i.digest)) && !params.spec.images.exists(i, i.runtime == r.runtime && i.version == r.version && i.architecture == r.architecture && c.endsWith('@' + i.digest) && !i.complete)))
validations.message: SENTRYCHECK: every app, init, and ephemeral image needs complete trusted reports for its immutable digest and exact runtime version/architecture.

validations.expression: variables.images.all(c, variables.managed.all(r, !params.spec.images.exists(i, i.runtime == r.runtime && i.version == r.version && i.architecture == r.architecture && c.endsWith('@' + i.digest) && i.hardFailure)))
validations.message: SENTRYCHECK: image has a confirmed hard-failure finding for the selected runtime.
